channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: There's a tongue for every boot in the BDSM fairy tale Pillion
item.description: Pillion is an unconventional love story using BDSM to thoughtfully explore ideas about long-term commitment.

item.title: Ditch exploitative streamers by participating in Bandcamp Friday
item.description: While streamers like Spotify, Apple Music, and TIDAL continue to be implicated in ICE raids, genocide, or human rights violations, Bandcamp is set to resume its periodical waiving of revenue share in support of artists tomorrow, February 6.

item.title: Dosa Divas cooks up tasty turn-based battles with a side of corporate critique
item.description: Dosa Divas is an upcoming turn-based RPG that combines a magic culinary mech with thoughtful family drama.

item.title: Melania is a case study in how not to sell a fascist regime
item.description: Brett Ratner dresses up his propaganda film Melania like an action movie, which only makes it a more revealing failure.

item.title: Laurence Fishburne takes the split-pea pill and joins Exorcist reboot
item.description: Mike Flanagan's fast-tracked The Exorcist finally makes artistic sense with Laurence Fishburne aboard. The movie is expected in 2027.

item.title: 5 songs you need to hear this week (February 5, 2026)
item.description: Featuring Rolling Blackouts Coastal Fever’s bright, blurred-edge jangle-rock, Nashpaints’ seven-minute mass of swirling noise, and The Messthetics & James Brandon Lewis’ red-hot punk bebop.

item.title: Hell is a repeating subway tunnel in the Exit 8 trailer
item.description: Based on the hit indie horror game, Neon's latest plays like the world's scariest version of a Highlights magazine puzzle.
